integrity: The proof is algebraic; exact finite-field enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Literature-search gaps remain and no independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Underlying reduced punctual Hilbert variety only, not possible embedded nilpotents, nonreduced local structures, scheme-theoretic intersection multiplicities, higher colengths or different characteristics. Known E6 coefficient is acknowledged as prior.
title: Quadric-cone components of length-four punctual Hilbert schemes at plane triple points
